Under legacy semantics, the default `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `flat` is false, as it is for an explicit `"multiindex"` setting. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index(n, snapshots, "snapshots")` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten component data when `flat` is false. Changes inside builders do not establish a change to the snapshots handed to them.
